subject: science
concept: Analyzing motion using kinematic equations (position, velocity, acceleration, time)
source_inspiration: adapted from Japan MEXT Courses of Study sequencing principles — original content, not copied text

exercise.concrete: Student times a physical object's motion and calculates its velocity and acceleration from measured data
exercise.pictorial: Student matches a described motion scenario to its correct kinematic graph (position-time, velocity-time)
exercise.abstract: Student solves for an unknown kinematic variable using the appropriate kinematic equation

misconception_flags: confuses which kinematic equation applies given the known and unknown variables in a problem

interest_binding: exercise regenerated using student's stated interest profile
